newsitem.title: CHINA: China Dagang first half crude output 2.18 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China Dagang first half crude output 2.18 mln T.

text.p: China's Dagang oilfield produced 2.18 million tonnes of crude oil and 193 million cubic metres of natural gas in the first half of the year, the China Industrial News said on Thursday.
The newspaper gave no comparative figures but said the field in the eastern city of Tianjin produced 4.34 million tonnes of crude in all of 1996.
Dagang had produced more than 100 million tonnes of crude since it went into operation in 1964, it said.

The oilfield now had annual production capacity of 4.3 million tonnes of crude oil and 360 million cubic metres of natural gas, and its annual oil processing capacity was 2.5 million tonnes, the newspaper said. It did not give further details.
China has been trying to stabilise production at Dagang and other relatively old oilfields in northeastern China such as the Huabei, Zhongyuan and Jidong fields.
Output growth is intended to come from newer fields in western regions.
China expects to produce 142 million tonnes of crude oil and 17 billion cubic metres of natural gas on land this year, state media have said.
